subject: Vendor activation: PO number issuance, spend cap controls & SKU line corrections
messages:
From: Lara Pruitt <lara@stratos-vendor.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procure Ops <procure-ops@stratos-vendor.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor activation: PO number and spend cap details

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the warm intro last week. We're ready to be activated in your procurement system, but we have a couple of open items before invoices can flow:

- PO number: please confirm whether Redwood will assign a single PO for the initial onboarding period or separate PO numbers per invoice. Our billing team prefers a single PO (PO 45210) for the initial month.
- Spend cap: we were told there would be an initial spend cap of $25k while usage profiling completes. Can you confirm who at Redwood sets and enforces that cap?
- Line items / SKUs: the invoice you shared earlier references two SKUs (STR-CORE and STR-SL). Our internal accounting flagged a mismatch between the SKU descriptions on the PO and the ones on our invoice. I've attached our W-9 and the invoice export for your review.

Attachments: Stratos_W-9.pdf, PO_45210_lineitems_v1.xlsx

Can we get a quick confirmation of the PO model (single vs per-invoice) and the effective spend cap today so we can finalize our billing run?

Best,
Lara Pruitt
Head of Finance Operations
Stratos Data, Inc.
[lara@stratos-vendor.com]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Pruitt <lara@stratos-vendor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: PO number and spend cap details

Hi Lara — thanks for sending these over and sorry for the delay in confirming. Quick answers up front:

- PO approach: We typically issue one PO per onboarding commitment period. For month one that's fine to use a single PO (we'll provision PO-45210 as you suggested).
- Spend cap owner: Finance (Ben) owns the enforcement; for operational throttling of billable usage we lean on platform limits (Stephanie).
- SKU mismatch: Can you paste the exact description strings for STR-CORE and STR-SL from your invoice? Our procurement system maps SKUs to internal catalog items and sometimes line descriptions differ by a few chars which breaks the PO-match.

Ben / Stephanie / Monica — can you confirm that Redwood will issue PO-45210 and set a temporary spend cap at $25,000 for Stratos Data and block any invoices beyond that until we confirm? Also advise the expected lead time to propagate the PO to AP so Lara can schedule billing.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Marcus / all —

We can issue PO-45210 today. Operational notes and next steps:

1) PO issuance
   - I'll create PO-45210 in Coupa (Redwood AP) and add Stratos Data as the vendor record. Expected propagation to the AP portal is ~4 business hours.
2) Spend cap enforcement
   - I'll set a hard spend cap of $25,000 on the PO line while we monitor usage. This will cause invoices over the cap to queue for manual approval — AP will hold them and notify Procure Ops.
3) Line-item / SKU reconciliation
   - Attached is a small mapping worksheet that shows our internal catalog strings vs. common external descriptions. Please update the invoice SKU descriptions to match our catalog exactly, or we can accept a mapping file if you prefer.

Attachment: PO_45210_lineitems_v1.xlsx (updated mapping tab)

Lara — can you confirm the following so we can close the onboarding:
- Confirm that your next invoice will reference PO-45210.
- Confirm you accept the $25k hard cap and understand that any overage will require manual approval and may delay payment.
- Provide the exact invoice line descriptions for STR-CORE and STR-SL (copy/paste is easiest).

If we get those today we can finalize and you should be visible to AP by EOD tomorrow.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
